title: resplendence — bedlam

sentences.sentence: We do not pursue one resplendence but development for ever.
sentences.translation: 我们不求一时之辉煌，但求永远的发展。

sentences.sentence: Let's create the warm resplendence together, and greet the polychrome spring.
sentences.translation: 让我们共同创造温暖的辉煌，迎接万紫千红的春天。

sentences.sentence: Modern Financial Theory (MFT) is facing more and more challenges after its resplendence , and among them is herding of stock market traders.
sentences.translation: 现代金融理论在经历辉煌之后正面临越来越多的挑战，证券市场交易者的羊群行为就是其中之一。

sentences.sentence: We were each handed a badge with our name on it.
sentences.translation: 我们每个人都拿到一个徽章，上面有我们的名字。

phrases.translation: 回顾；回顾往事；检讨过去

sentences.sentence: In retrospect, I wonder if we should have done more.
sentences.translation: 回过头看，我在想我们是否应该做得更多些。

sentences.sentence: He received a humiliating rebuff from his manager.
sentences.translation: 他遭到经理的断然拒绝，十分丢脸。

sentences.sentence: Deposit any random checks you get - like rebate, rewards or reimbursement checks - into this fund.
sentences.translation: 把你挣的随机钱——比如像回扣，鉴赏，或偿款等——存到这个基金里。

sentences.sentence: I placed an order for desktop pc memory which came with a $20 MIR [mail in rebate].
sentences.translation: 我订购了一个价值20美元的桌面个人电脑存储器，可以申请回扣的。

sentences.sentence: What you beheld was the interior of a cloister.
sentences.translation: 你所看见的是一个修道院的内部。

sentences.sentence: Some people go to a cloister in order to avoid problems of everyday life, and Yuri came to a circus.
sentences.translation: 为了逃避生活中的烦恼，有的人会选择去修道院。 但是尤里选择了去马戏团。

sentences.sentence: It’s probably dangerous to enter exclusively into this realm and risk being caught in a cloister, removed from the market and its accountability.
sentences.translation: 如果专门只进入这个领域并且冒着陷于修道院、远离尘世及其责任的风险很可能是危险的。

translations.translation: 回想, 记忆力, 怀旧

sentences.sentence: Here I am boring you with my reminiscences.
sentences.translation: 我的这些陈年老事让你烦了吧。

sentences.sentence: Blankfein was clearly trying to placate the locals and show some kind of contrition.
sentences.translation: 布兰克费恩显然在尽力抚慰德国人，并表现出一定的悔悟。

sentences.sentence: An active conscience is a fine and healthy thing, of course. But contrition must not be limited to certain parties while innocence is accorded to anyone who claims to be persecuted.
sentences.translation: 这种悔恨的思潮像流行病一样传遍了民间与政府，适度的表现良知是件好事，但是悔悟不应该仅仅局限于当事人一方，清白也不应该给予任何一个自称受到迫害的人。

sentences.sentence: The 160-metre falls mark the dramatic confluence of the rivers Nera and Velino.
sentences.translation: 这处160米的瀑布是维拉河和维里诺河壮观的汇合处的标志。

translations.translation: 汇款, 汇寄之款, 汇款额

sentences.sentence: Please enclose your remittance, making checks payable to Valley Technology Services.
sentences.translation: 请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。

sentences.sentence: We must send our most trusted officer to parley with their leaders for an exchange of prisoners.
sentences.translation: 为了交换俘虏我们必须派一名可靠的军官去与他们的领导人谈判。

sentences.sentence: Then be began to parley with me.
sentences.translation: 然后他开始跟我谈判。

sentences.sentence: We found him lying at the bottom of the stairs in a drunken stupor .
sentences.translation: 我们发现他躺在楼梯口，醉得不省人事。

phrases.translation: 糖尿病性昏睡；糖尿病昏迷症

sentences.sentence: She was in a coma for seven weeks.
sentences.translation: 她昏迷了七周。

sentences.sentence: She became immersed in planning her nuptials.
sentences.translation: 她一门心思筹备她的婚礼。

sentences.sentence: His bathroom is a brilliant pastiche of expensive interior design.
sentences.translation: 他的浴室是高档室内设计的集大成之作。

sentences.sentence: Salt and sugar intermingle with each other.
sentences.translation: 糖和盐相互混合在一起。

sentences.sentence: In the image, dust is red, hot gas is green and white is where gas and dust intermingle. Foreground and background stars appear scattered through the image.
sentences.translation: 在该图像中，尘埃为红色，热气体为绿色，气体与尘埃混合处为白色，前景和背景中的恒星遍布整个图像。

sentences.sentence: Women have more sensitive smell receptors than men and prefer certain scents only when they're fresh, such as androstenol, which is emitted when sweat and oxygen intermingle [source: Fox].
sentences.translation: 女人的嗅觉器官要比男人敏锐得多。 她们对某些气味有偏好，尤其当这些气味是新鲜的时候，比如男性荷尔蒙，当汗水和氧气混合时就会散发这种气味。

sentences.sentence: A minor diplomatic kerfuffle ensued as it turned out the cream was being illegally imported from Vietnam.
sentences.translation: 随后就引发一场小型外交动乱，因为美白乳是从越南非法进口的。

sentences.sentence: But the lifecycle for a blog-related kerfuffle is a few days in general, and the blogosphere as a whole has an extreme attention deficit disorder.
sentences.translation: 但是通常来说，一个与博客相关的混乱生命周期只有几天。 在整个博客范围作却非常注意不足和混乱。

sentences.sentence: Amid all the kerfuffle around Kosovo's declaration of independence, few have paused to note what an extraordinary document it is.
sentences.translation: 在科索沃宣告独立所引起的一片混乱中，很少有人注意到这份独立宣言是多么不同寻常的文件：其中充斥着条件、责任和保留意见。

translations.translation: 混乱, 断层, 脱臼

phrases.translation: 刃型位错；边缘位错；刃差排

sentences.sentence: Millions of refugees have suffered a total dislocation of their lives.
sentences.translation: 几百万难民饱受生活颠沛流离之苦。

translations.translation: 混乱, 混沌(宇宙未形成前的情形)

phrases.translation: [数]决定性混沌；命定混沌（等于chaos）

sentences.sentence: The country was plunged into economic chaos.
sentences.translation: 这个国家陷入了经济大混乱。

translations.translation: 混乱, 骚乱情景, <古语>疯人院

sentences.sentence: When the bomb exploded, there was bedlam.
sentences.translation: 炸弹爆炸以后，现场一片混乱。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 181 单元

resplendence
n. 辉煌, 灿烂
例句：We do not pursue one resplendence but development for ever.
我们不求一时之辉煌，但求永远的发展。
例句：Let's create the warm resplendence together, and greet the polychrome spring.
让我们共同创造温暖的辉煌，迎接万紫千红的春天。
例句：Modern Financial Theory (MFT) is facing more and more challenges after its resplendence , and among them is herding of stock market traders.
现代金融理论在经历辉煌之后正面临越来越多的挑战，证券市场交易者的羊群行为就是其中之一。

badge
音标：英 /bædʒ/  美 /bædʒ/
n. 徽章, 证章
例句：We were each handed a badge with our name on it.
我们每个人都拿到一个徽章，上面有我们的名字。

retrospect
音标：英 /'retrəspekt/  美 /'rɛtrəspɛkt/
n. 回顾
短语：in retrospect — 回顾；回顾往事；检讨过去
例句：In retrospect, I wonder if we should have done more.
回过头看，我在想我们是否应该做得更多些。

rebuff
音标：英 /rɪ'bʌf/  美 /rɪ'bʌf/
n. 回绝
例句：He received a humiliating rebuff from his manager.
他遭到经理的断然拒绝，十分丢脸。

rebate
音标：英 /'riːbeɪt/  美 /'ribet/
n. 回扣, 折扣
短语：tax rebate — 退税；税收回扣
短语：export tax rebate system — 出口退税机制
例句：Deposit any random checks you get - like rebate, rewards or reimbursement checks - into this fund.
把你挣的随机钱——比如像回扣，鉴赏，或偿款等——存到这个基金里。
例句：I placed an order for desktop pc memory which came with a $20 MIR [mail in rebate].
我订购了一个价值20美元的桌面个人电脑存储器，可以申请回扣的。

cloister
音标：英 /'klɒɪstə/  美 /'klɔɪstɚ/
n. 回廊, 修道院
例句：What you beheld was the interior of a cloister.
你所看见的是一个修道院的内部。
例句：Some people go to a cloister in order to avoid problems of everyday life, and Yuri came to a circus.
为了逃避生活中的烦恼，有的人会选择去修道院。 但是尤里选择了去马戏团。
例句：It’s probably dangerous to enter exclusively into this realm and risk being caught in a cloister, removed from the market and its accountability.
如果专门只进入这个领域并且冒着陷于修道院、远离尘世及其责任的风险很可能是危险的。

reminiscence
音标：英 /remɪ'nɪs(ə)ns/  美 /'rɛmə'nɪsns/
n. 回想, 记忆力, 怀旧
例句：Here I am boring you with my reminiscences.
我的这些陈年老事让你烦了吧。

contrition
音标：英 /kən'trɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /kən'triʃən/
n. 悔悟, 后悔
例句：Blankfein was clearly trying to placate the locals and show some kind of contrition.
布兰克费恩显然在尽力抚慰德国人，并表现出一定的悔悟。
例句：An active conscience is a fine and healthy thing, of course. But contrition must not be limited to certain parties while innocence is accorded to anyone who claims to be persecuted.
这种悔恨的思潮像流行病一样传遍了民间与政府，适度的表现良知是件好事，但是悔悟不应该仅仅局限于当事人一方，清白也不应该给予任何一个自称受到迫害的人。

confluence
音标：英 /'kɒnflʊəns/  美 /'kɑnfluəns/
n. 汇合
例句：The 160-metre falls mark the dramatic confluence of the rivers Nera and Velino.
这处160米的瀑布是维拉河和维里诺河壮观的汇合处的标志。

remittance
音标：英 /rɪ'mɪt(ə)ns/  美 /rɪ'mɪtns/
n. 汇款, 汇寄之款, 汇款额
短语：remittance slip — [经]汇款凭单
短语：postal remittance — [经]邮政划拨
短语：outward remittance — [经]汇出汇款
短语：bank remittance — 银行汇款底单
短语：inward remittance — 汇入汇款
例句：Please enclose your remittance, making checks payable to Valley Technology Services.
请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。

parley
音标：英 /'pɑːlɪ/  美 /'pɑrli/
n. 会谈
例句：We must send our most trusted officer to parley with their leaders for an exchange of prisoners.
为了交换俘虏我们必须派一名可靠的军官去与他们的领导人谈判。
例句：Then be began to parley with me.
然后他开始跟我谈判。

stupor
音标：英 /'stjuːpə/  美 /'stupɚ/
n. 昏迷
例句：We found him lying at the bottom of the stairs in a drunken stupor .
我们发现他躺在楼梯口，醉得不省人事。

coma
音标：英 /'kəʊmə/  美 /'komə/
n. 昏迷
短语：in a coma — 陷于昏迷
短语：diabetic coma — 糖尿病性昏睡；糖尿病昏迷症
例句：She was in a coma for seven weeks.
她昏迷了七周。

nuptial
音标：英 /'nʌpʃ(ə)l/  美 /'nʌpʃl/
n. 婚礼
例句：She became immersed in planning her nuptials.
她一门心思筹备她的婚礼。

pastiche
音标：英 /pæ'stiːʃ/  美 /pæs'ti:ʃ, pɑ:/
n. 混成曲, 模仿画
例句：His bathroom is a brilliant pastiche of expensive interior design.
他的浴室是高档室内设计的集大成之作。

intermingle
音标：英 /ɪntə'mɪŋg(ə)l/  美 /,ɪntɚ'mɪŋɡl/
n. 混合
短语：intermingle with — 混合
例句：Salt and sugar intermingle with each other.
糖和盐相互混合在一起。
例句：In the image, dust is red, hot gas is green and white is where gas and dust intermingle. Foreground and background stars appear scattered through the image.
在该图像中，尘埃为红色，热气体为绿色，气体与尘埃混合处为白色，前景和背景中的恒星遍布整个图像。
例句：Women have more sensitive smell receptors than men and prefer certain scents only when they're fresh, such as androstenol, which is emitted when sweat and oxygen intermingle [source: Fox].
女人的嗅觉器官要比男人敏锐得多。 她们对某些气味有偏好，尤其当这些气味是新鲜的时候，比如男性荷尔蒙，当汗水和氧气混合时就会散发这种气味。

kerfuffle
音标：英 /kə'fʌf(ə)l/  美 /kɚ'fʌfl/
n. 混乱, 动乱
例句：A minor diplomatic kerfuffle ensued as it turned out the cream was being illegally imported from Vietnam.
随后就引发一场小型外交动乱，因为美白乳是从越南非法进口的。
例句：But the lifecycle for a blog-related kerfuffle is a few days in general, and the blogosphere as a whole has an extreme attention deficit disorder.
但是通常来说，一个与博客相关的混乱生命周期只有几天。 在整个博客范围作却非常注意不足和混乱。
例句：Amid all the kerfuffle around Kosovo's declaration of independence, few have paused to note what an extraordinary document it is.
在科索沃宣告独立所引起的一片混乱中，很少有人注意到这份独立宣言是多么不同寻常的文件：其中充斥着条件、责任和保留意见。

dislocation
音标：英 /,dɪslə(ʊ)'keɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,dɪslo'keʃən/
n. 混乱, 断层, 脱臼
短语：dislocation density — 位错密度；差排密度
短语：screw dislocation — 螺旋位错；螺旋变位
短语：edge dislocation — 刃型位错；边缘位错；刃差排
短语：dislocation motion — 位错运动
例句：Millions of refugees have suffered a total dislocation of their lives.
几百万难民饱受生活颠沛流离之苦。

chaos
音标：英 /'keɪɒs/  美 /'keɑs/
n. 混乱, 混沌(宇宙未形成前的情形)
短语：in chaos — 混乱；纷乱
短语：chaos theory — 混沌理论
短语：chaos and confusion — 混乱与浑沌
短语：deterministic chaos — [数]决定性混沌；命定混沌（等于chaos）
例句：The country was plunged into economic chaos.
这个国家陷入了经济大混乱。

bedlam
音标：英 /'bedləm/  美 /'bɛdləm/
n. 混乱, 骚乱情景, <古语>疯人院
例句：When the bomb exploded, there was bedlam.
炸弹爆炸以后，现场一片混乱。
